title: Winter Jam
seo_title: Winter Jam 2027 Christian Music Night in Springfield, MO
description: Winter Jam is a night of Christian music and worship featuring Crowder, Anne Wilson, Andy Mineo ft. Magic & Bird, Strings & Heart, Terrian, Red, and NewSong, plus a message from speaker Zane Black. A Pre-Jam Party with Natural State, CJ Emulous, and Mary-Clair starts earlier in the evening. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena in Springfield, MO; no advance tickets are needed, and entry is a $15 donation at the door, with parking at $20.
